From: QuickPack Foods <dispatch@quickpack.example>
Subject: Delay on open orders PO-2041 and PO-2042

Hi team, due to a packaging film shortage at our converter, PO-2041 (Roasted Makhana Peri Peri 90g) and PO-2042 (Millet Chips Tomato 70g) will be delayed by 9 days. We will share revised dispatch dates by Friday. Apologies for the inconvenience.

From: Marketing (Riya)
Subject: Creator campaign next week

Heads-up: a fitness creator with 1.2M followers will feature our Peanut Butter Crunchy 1kg on Oct 15. Based on the last collab we expect roughly 3x normal demand for about 10 days. Please make sure we don't run out.

From: Warehouse Ops (Bengaluru DC)
Subject: Short-dated stock

Cycle count note: lot LOT-013-A of Cold Brew Coffee 250ml (420 units) has best-before 2026-10-25. At the current run-rate a large part of it will not sell through in time. Please advise on clearance.
note: 'a large part' of 420 units: any count between 200 and 420 is accepted

text:
From: Marketplace Ops (Karan)
Subject: Amazon listing issue - Kombucha

FYI: Amazon has suppressed our Kombucha Ginger Lemon 330ml listing from Oct 14 because the label images failed their new compliance check. Reinstatement usually takes about 10 days. Amazon is roughly 30% of this SKU's sales, so expect demand to drop to around 0.7x until Oct 23. Other channels are unaffected.

From: NutriSource Labs <logistics@nutrisource.example>
Subject: RE: PO-2044 dispatch status

Hello, the imported softgel shells for PO-2044 (Omega-3 Fish Oil 60 caps) are held at Nhava Sheva customs for a document query. Our clearing agent expects release next week, so please plan for the delivery to arrive about 6 days later than the confirmed date. All other NutriSource orders are on schedule.
Bhai, QuickPack wale bol rahe hain ki Ragi Crackers 150g ka next lot 5 din late aayega, film supply ka issue hai. Plan accordingly.
नमस्ते टीम, NutriSource से संदेश: PO-2043 (Protein Bar Peanut Choco 6-pack) की डिलीवरी ट्रक न मिलने के कारण 4 दिन देर से पहुंचेगी।

text: Swiggy Instamart has confirmed our Honey Granola 450g in its 'Healthy breakfast' carousel from Oct 16 to Oct 22. Last time a carousel slot lifted sales by about 40%.

Two things from today's call:
1) GreenField is short of glass jars, so Almond Butter 500g dispatch will slip by 5 days.
2) Marketing is running a 20% off weekend on Millet Muesli 400g on Oct 17-18; we expect around 1.5x sales on those two days.
Influencer collab confirm ho gaya! Apple Cider Vinegar Gummies 60 ka reel 18 Oct ko live hoga. Pichli baar aise reel ke baad ek hafte tak 2x demand thi.
Amazon Great Indian Festival: lightning deals on our Multivitamin Women 60 tabs and Vitamin D3 + K2 60 caps on Oct 22-24. Amazon's category team expects roughly 2.5x normal sales on the deal days.
दिवाली ऑफर: Roasted Makhana Himalayan Salt 90g पर 1 से 9 नवंबर तक 20% छूट रहेगी, बिक्री लगभग डेढ़ गुना होने की उम्मीद है।
Blinkit is delisting Overnight Oats Berry 500g from its Bengaluru dark stores from Oct 20 for two weeks (range review). Blinkit Bengaluru is about a fifth of that SKU's sales.

Sales heads-up: a rival launched a cheaper electrolyte drink at half our price. Overall sales of our Electrolyte Drink Orange 500ml are down about 25% since Oct 10 and we expect that to continue for the next month.
Café chain BeanStop is dropping our Cold Brew Coffee 250ml from its menu from Oct 15. They took about half of our cold brew volume.

Team update:
- NutriSource: PO-2043 3 din late.
- Whey Protein Vanilla 1kg ka Flipkart deal 20-22 Oct, approx 2x.
- Baaki sab theek.

Protein Cookies Oat 4-pack ka LOT-006-A 28 Oct ko expire ho raha hai, approx 150 packs pade hain. Kuch karo yaar.
Several Coconut Water 1L cartons at the Pune DC are close to best-before (Oct 24). Count pending.
note: no unit count given: any magnitude is accepted

text: Hi, please ignore my earlier mail about PO-2042. The film shipment reached us this morning and Millet Chips Tomato 70g will ship on the original date. No delay.
Correction: the Honey Granola carousel on Instamart is cancelled - Instamart pulled all breakfast carousels this month. Please ignore the uplift I mentioned.
There might be some delay on the NutriSource side next week, they haven't confirmed anything yet. Will update once I hear back.
Featured in a newspaper piece on healthy snacking today: our Baked Chickpea Puffs 60g. Could bump sales a bit, no idea how much.
note: unquantified: a small spike on SKU-012 is tolerated but not required

text: Reminder: the quarterly stock audit is on Oct 28. Please make sure all bins are labelled before Oct 27.
